text: Hi, Phong. Where are you going?
I'm going to the new shopping mall in the city centre.
Oh, I love shopping malls. They have everything you need in one place.
Yes, but the prices are often higher than in the open-air market.
True, but it's more convenient. You don't have to bargain, and there's air conditioning!
My mum prefers going to the traditional market. She says the food is fresher.
I prefer shopping online. I can browse different stores and read reviews before buying anything.
Do you ever buy things on sale?
All the time! I always look for discount coupons.
